decisions.reason: The centered localization condition admitted every adapted nonintegrable constant process, so it did not define the standard local-martingale class. Requiring integrability of X_0 makes the centered and uncentered stopped-martingale formulations equivalent and excludes that counterexample.

The cited Lp supplier establishes a quotient norm and its triangle inequality, but not an inner-product representation. That excess sentence was unused: every proof step needs only quotient well-definedness, linearity, and the triangle inequality, so removing it repairs the fact without changing the theorem.

The general-integrand argument required an actual deterministic step approximation, while the cited choice axiom supplied no density result. The repair derives the sequence from the published box-step density theorem after zero extension and restriction. Review also removed an unnecessary probability-space Cauchy--Schwarz citation, replacing it with the reverse triangle inequality in the supplied L2 normed space.

The proof and statement explicitly establish a continuous local martingale only on the stochastic interval before the exit lifetime, with localizers increasing to tau_U rather than infinity. The unqualified title overstated that interface, but the operative clauses were already correct, so qualifying the title repairs a non-load-bearing defect.
